name: ingo-eng-guidelines
description: Ingo Schindler's reusable engineering guideline skills shared across projects.

plugins.name: book-guidelines
plugins.description: Book-derived engineering guidelines (Clean Code, Clean Architecture, PoEAA, HPJP, Modern Software Engineering, Philosophy of Software Design) plus PR-review/prototyping/behavioral skills — none of it tied to a specific project's domain.

plugins.name: epic-workflow
plugins.description: Idea capture through epic definition, planning, and task execution, with GitHub Projects V2 sync — parameterized per project via its own CLAUDE.md, not tied to any one project's domain.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Backend (Hexagonal Architecture, one class per use case) and frontend (web-components, BCE) architecture doctrine — the standard Ingo starts every project from, with no remaining links into any one project's own docs.

plugins.name: quarkus-tooling
plugins.description: Vendored third-party Quarkus and Keycloak-administration skills (MIT-licensed), installed once instead of copy-pasted per project.
